{{Top}}
'''Thisspiasian''' was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Thisspiasian/Legends|Thisspiasian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Thisspias/Legends|Thisspias]].<ref name="u">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

Thisspiasian was a complex language that used interlocking sentences. From a phonological perspective, it makes a heavy use of sibilants (including ''s'', ''z'' and derivates like ''sh'').<ref name="u" />

Most Thisspiasians were fluent in both Thisspiasian language and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], although they were only literate in their own language.<ref name="u" />
